inputs.source: Analysis output; includes every prompt number, model hypothesis and assumption; no engineering acceptance is graded.

missing_data.what: The surface card: position and load samples over one full stroke, with units
missing_data.why: The wave equation is solved from the measured polished-rod position and load.
missing_data.effect: Without it there is no calculation; stop. The samples are ASSUMED evenly spaced in time.
missing_data.how_to_supply: Export the card from the pump-off controller or dynamometer as position (in) and load (lbf) columns, in acquisition order.

missing_data.what: The rod string as run: diameter, length and material of each taper, surface first
missing_data.why: Rod stretch, wave travel time and buoyant rod weight come from the taper geometry.
missing_data.effect: Without diameter or length there is no calculation; stop. A missing material is ASSUMED steel. Rod length: On the public example well a 1 % error in it changes: pump stroke −0.35, fluid load 0.87 (stepped), fillage 0.46, maximum pump load −1.64, displacement 0.11 (% per %). Rod diameter: On the public example well a 1 % error in it changes: pump stroke 0.58, fluid load −0.17 (stepped), fillage −0.94, maximum pump load −3.14, displacement −0.36 (% per %).
missing_data.how_to_supply: Take it from the rod tally or the last workover ticket; a remembered string is weaker evidence than the tally.

missing_data.what: Pump setting depth and plunger diameter
missing_data.why: The pump depth closes the rod string; the plunger diameter converts plunger travel to volume.
missing_data.effect: Without either there is no calculation; stop. Plunger diameter: On the public example well a 1 % error in it changes: pump stroke < 0.01 in magnitude, fluid load < 0.01 in magnitude, fillage < 0.01 in magnitude, maximum pump load < 0.01 in magnitude, displacement 2.00 (% per %).
missing_data.how_to_supply: Take both from the pump or completion record.

missing_data.what: Pumping speed in strokes per minute
missing_data.why: Speed sets the time of one stroke and so the dynamic part of the rod load.
missing_data.effect: Without it there is no calculation; stop. On the public example well a 1 % error in it changes: pump stroke −0.06, fluid load 0.93 (stepped), fillage < 0.01 in magnitude, maximum pump load 0.04, displacement 0.93 (% per %).
missing_data.how_to_supply: Read it from the controller, or time ten strokes.

missing_data.why: Every pump load is the surface load less the buoyant rod weight, so a load-cell error passes straight into it.
missing_data.effect: If not supplied, the surface loads are ASSUMED correct as recorded. On the public example well a 1 % error in it changes: pump stroke −0.29, fluid load 0.94 (stepped), fillage 0.47, maximum pump load 2.57, displacement 0.18 (% per %). The effect of a zero offset is NOT_EVALUATED.
missing_data.how_to_supply: Give the date of the last calibration and whether the cell was zeroed unloaded.

missing_data.what: Fluid density, or water cut with oil and water densities
missing_data.why: Fluid density sets the buoyancy of the rod string.
missing_data.effect: If not supplied, fluid density is ASSUMED 62.4 lb/ft3 (fresh water). On the public example well a 1 % error in it changes: pump stroke 0.00, fluid load 0.00, fillage 0.00, maximum pump load 0.22, displacement 0.00 (% per %).
missing_data.how_to_supply: Give the produced-fluid density or the water cut and the two phase densities.

missing_data.why: Unanchored tubing stretches with the fluid load and shortens the plunger travel relative to the barrel.
missing_data.effect: If not supplied, anchored tubing is ASSUMED; pump stroke, fillage and displacement rest on it. Unanchored tubing is not modelled and its effect is NOT_EVALUATED.
missing_data.how_to_supply: State anchored or unanchored, with the anchor depth.

missing_data.why: In a deviated well, rod weight and friction act along the well path.
missing_data.effect: If not supplied, a vertical well is ASSUMED. The frequency-domain cross-check is always vertical. The effect of deviation is NOT_EVALUATED without a survey.
missing_data.how_to_supply: Give measured depth, inclination and azimuth from surface to the pump.

missing_data.why: It is used for pump intake pressure, which this report does not give.
missing_data.effect: If not supplied, 100 psi is ASSUMED; none of the reported card results uses it.

cannot_do: Name a pump fault with a stated field accuracy: every shape label is a HYPOTHESIS; field accuracy is NOT_EVALUATED because independent labelled field cards are unavailable.
Analyse a deviated well as vertical without saying so; the frequency-domain cross-check is vertical.
Correct a mis-calibrated load cell without independent calibration evidence.
Give production from a card alone: operating runtime and plunger/valve slip are needed.
Establish a published-example check without an openly readable worked example with tabulated card values; it is NOT_EVALUATED.
